description: Daily-reset leveraged ETFs and the fund that tracks the same index. Support zones, trend confirmation and history paths for these funds are built on the underlying and translated with a one-session leverage estimate. fee_drag is the all-in yearly cost assumed on top of financing (2 x the 3-month T-bill on the borrowed exposure); swap spreads and slippage are not modeled.

TECL.index: Technology Select Sector Index (XLK tracks it)

SOXL.index: ICE Semiconductor Index (SOXX tracks it; SMH tracks a different index)
